title: The vine's long walk
summary: საქართველო. One vine, eight thousand years long, grows from a qvevri in the Georgian valley of the oldest wine across the world as the years play; touch it and light runs back the way it came.

doorway.label: The vine's long walk: a vine leaf in the Georgian valley where the oldest wine was made

whatsNew.what: One vine, eight thousand years long, grows out of a buried qvevri in Georgia as the years play; touch any stem and light runs back to where it began.
whatsNew.ask: Did you want to touch it before you knew what it was?
